document: R2c PRE-REGISTRATION — the head over the AGENT'S OWN KV cache, written before the build (理
who_set_it: 理, in ri+sautee 11300. R2b's §4 was offered as an observation, not a rescue; 理 ruled it is not a rescue but the accounting the measured system got wrong, and pre-registered R2c on the spot. This file is that pre-registration, recorded before a line of the implementation exists.
the_claim_being_tested: the 492-token decision prompt is one the AGENT PREFILLS ANYWAY in order to act. The measured system paid for it k+1 times: once for the agent's own generation, and k more for the controller's candidate passes. A controller that reads its state from the pass the agent already makes pays only the continuations.
the_bar: UNCHANGED at 502 tokens/episode. Same number, same derivation (r2b_prereg.json: 0.71 actions x 707 tokens/action from an OLS fit over the base's 300 episodes). It is not re-derived for this measurement and it is not adjusted to fit.
what_counts_as_a_token: ONLY tokens the agent would not otherwise have paid. The shared decision prompt is NOT charged, because it is prefilled by the agent's own forward pass whether or not a controller exists. The candidate continuations ARE charged. This accounting rule is the whole substance of R2c and it is written here before the number.
expectation_written_before_the_build: 36-180 tokens/episode. The low end is R2b's measured continuation cost (36.1); the high end allows for a longer per-candidate suffix. Under the bar, so the pre-written reading is that it PASSES.

THE_READINGS_WRITTEN_FIRST.<= 502 AND the cache is genuinely shared: the cost limb passes on tokens, and G is an experience prior under 8a §3 with C in tokens. 8a's cost sentence changes.
THE_READINGS_WRITTEN_FIRST.> 502: it fails and 8a carries the premium, unchanged from R2 and R2b.
THE_READINGS_WRITTEN_FIRST.the implementation CANNOT share the cach: if reading the state requires a pass the agent does not otherwise make -- a different prompt, a different position, a cache the generation loop has already consumed or mutated past the point of interest -- then R2c FAILS by construction and 8a carries the premium. A shared cache that has to be rebuilt is not a shared cache. This branch is written now precisely so that discovering it later is a result and not a disappointment.

the_identity_check_is_mandatory_and_void: as in R2b: the state the shared-cache path returns must reproduce hidden_at at the same layer and the same read position, at r ~ 1.0 with max|diff| at the bf16 floor. Anything else and the token number is VOID and reported as void. R2b is the reason this is non-negotiable -- there, a cost number that cleared the bar was produced by a path reading the WRONG STATE, and the bug was only visible because the check existed.
scale: one build, one run of 300. Not a sweep, not a tuning exercise.
what_this_does_NOT_touch: the benefit limb. The action saving and the +11.3/+13.0/+14.0/+13.3 accuracy results are not re-run and not re-opened by R2c.
position_in_the_package: the LAST item of 8a. 理: 'This is the LAST item of 8a's package; nothing after it.' Order: R4 -> R2c -> 8a stops -> loop gates from 理 -> the loop.
bounds_known_in_advance: The agent generates with temperature 0 and its own sampling loop; the controller reads a state from the PREFILL. If the harness's generate() does not expose the prefill's hidden states without a second pass, that is the 'cannot share the cache' branch above and must be reported as such rather than worked around with a second pass quietly counted as free.
Tokens are counted as prompt tokens, matching r2b_prereg.json's rule.
